records.record_text: The Mission also visited the places where the frontier incidents described below occurred: (i) The village of Mant... five persons (three women and two children) had been killed, six civilians had been wounded...; (ii) The hamlet of Taey... seven provincial guards had been killed, and the Mission found evidence of caterpillar tracks of armoured vehicles and bomb craters; (iii) The villages of Kauk Khpos, Anlong Kres and Thlok... seventeen Cambodian soldiers had been killed and seven wounded...; (vii) The hamlet of Koh Sko... the Mission saw the remains of burnt-out dwellings and grenades which had been abandoned unused.
records.political_signal: null
records.policy_implication: The mission's direct observation of damage and casualties provided factual grounding for its subsequent analysis and recommendations, confirming the basis of Cambodia's complaint.

records.record_text: The evidence collected and the facts noted on the spot confirm that the resolution adopted by the Security Council was opportune.
records.political_signal: null
records.policy_implication: This finding validates the Security Council's decision to address the complaint and send the mission, confirming the legitimacy of the initial concerns.

records.record_text: The Mission considered that the violations of the Cambodian frontier were the symptom rather than the cause of the strained relations between the two countries; it accordingly examined a number of specific proposals designed to improve those relations.
records.political_signal: null
records.policy_implication: This core analytical finding shifted the Mission's focus from merely investigating incidents to addressing the underlying political disputes, shaping its entire approach and subsequent recommendations.

records.record_text: The two Governments reaffirmed their desire to improve relations and took the view that the resumption of political relations broken off on 26 August 1963 would be a significant contribution towards reducing tension between their two countries.
records.actor_source: Government of Cambodia, Government of the Republic of Viet-Nam
records.political_signal: Both parties signal a willingness to de-escalate and engage diplomatically, providing a crucial entry point for the mission's proposals.
records.policy_implication: This shared position provides the basis for the mission's recommendations regarding the resumption of diplomatic relations.

records.record_text: In addition to the ancient rivalries and suspicions between the two countries, there are fundamental differences between the policies each has decided to adopt. Cambodia has chosen a policy of neutrality. The Republic of Viet-Nam has made a different choice by unequivocally taking sides in the conflict which brought the great Powers face to face in that part of the world.
records.political_signal: null
records.policy_implication: Identifies the geopolitical context (Cold War alignment vs. neutrality) as a core driver of the conflict, suggesting that a sustainable solution must account for these divergent foreign policies.

records.record_text: The Government of the Republic of Viet-Nam has informed the Mission that it recognizes the neutrality of Cambodia and undertakes to respect it.
records.actor_source: Government of the Republic of Viet-Nam
records.actor_target: UN Security Council Mission, Government of Cambodia
records.political_signal: This is a significant political statement and confidence-building measure from Viet-Nam aimed at reassuring Cambodia and demonstrating goodwill.
records.policy_implication: This commitment became a key element for the mission to build upon, forming the basis of a specific recommendation for the Security Council to formally note.

records.record_text: The Royal Government of Cambodia, in turn, has assured the Mission that it intends to refrain from any interference in the domestic affairs of the Republic of Viet-Nam and that it has no territorial claims against that country.
records.actor_target: UN Security Council Mission, Government of the Republic of Viet-Nam
records.political_signal: Cambodia provides a reciprocal assurance of non-interference, a key signal of its commitment to peaceful coexistence.
records.policy_implication: This assurance, paired with Viet-Nam's, helped the mission conclude that the land border was not fundamentally in dispute, allowing focus on other issues.

records.record_text: The Royal Government of Cambodia nevertheless feels obliged to point out that the Republic of Viet-Nam, in a note of 12 March 1960, laid claim to the islands lying off the coast of Cambodia... Before political relations between the two countries can be resumed, Cambodia must receive satisfaction on this point.
records.political_signal: Cambodia establishes a clear pre-condition for the resumption of diplomatic relations, creating a significant hurdle for negotiations.
records.policy_implication: This identifies the off-shore islands as a primary obstacle, which the mission must address to broker a broader agreement.

records.record_text: The Mission found that there is no territorial dispute between the two countries so far as the land frontier is concerned.
records.political_signal: null
records.policy_implication: This crucial assessment narrows the scope of the territorial dispute to the off-shore islands, making the land border issue one of technical demarcation rather than sovereign contestation.

records.record_text: The Government of the Republic of Viet-Nam proposes that the two countries should, by joint agreement, fix the line of their common frontier on the basis of a reference map chosen by both Parties and should then mark out this line on the ground.
records.actor_source: Government of the Republic of Viet-Nam
records.political_signal: null
records.policy_implication: Viet-Nam prioritizes a technical solution to border incidents, contrasting with Cambodia's focus on prior political settlement.

records.record_text: The Royal Government of Cambodia... is nevertheless prepared to enter into negotiations with the Government of the Republic of Viet-Nam in order to settle the question of the frontier line, as soon as political relations have been resumed.
records.political_signal: Cambodia signals its willingness to discuss border demarcation but clearly sequences it as a secondary step after the re-establishment of political relations.
records.policy_implication: This highlights the differing priorities and sequencing preferred by the two parties, a key challenge for mediation.

records.record_text: The Royal Government would agree to the dispatch of United Nations civilian observers if so decided by the Security Council.
records.political_signal: In a gesture of goodwill, Cambodia opens the door to a UN presence on its territory as an interim confidence-building measure.
records.policy_implication: This provides the mission with a concrete, actionable proposal to recommend to the Security Council.

records.record_text: The mandate of such observers should be confined to the Cambodian side of the frontier, their mission being to report on any incidents and acts of aggression committed against Cambodia. They would not be empowered to cross the frontier in order to investigate the origins of any aggression.
records.political_signal: Cambodia sets strict parameters on any UN presence, emphasizing that its purpose would be to observe and report on aggression against its territory, reflecting deep-seated security concerns.
records.policy_implication: These conditions define the limited scope of what is acceptable to Cambodia and would likely be a point of contention for Viet-Nam, which seeks a more comprehensive cross-border mechanism.

records.record_text: The situation in the frontier region nevertheless remains strained, and the Mission welcomes the fact that the two Governments have taken a positive attitude and have contemplated measures to reduce the risk of further incidents.
records.political_signal: null
records.policy_implication: Despite positive gestures, the underlying risk of conflict persists, underscoring the urgency for the Security Council to act on the mission's recommendations.

records.record_text: The obstacles to normal relations derived mainly from pride and mutual distrust - the outcome of age-old rivalries; the different historical circumstances in which the two States obtained their independence; and more recently, the divergent paths they have chosen in the matter of international politics.
records.political_signal: null
records.policy_implication: This assessment highlights that the conflict has deep historical and political roots, implying that a purely technical or legal solution will be insufficient.

records.record_text: The Mission recommends that the Security Council decide to establish a group of United Nations observers, which would be sent to Cambodia.
records.political_signal: null
records.policy_implication: This is the primary operational recommendation of the report, suggesting a tangible UN presence on the ground to monitor the situation.

records.record_text: The Mission recommends... That the Security Council should appeal to the Governments of the Kingdom of Cambodia and the Republic of Viet-Nam to adopt whatever measures are necessary to bring about the resumption of the political relations broken off in August 1963.
records.actor_target: UN Security Council, Government of Cambodia, Government of the Republic of Viet-Nam
records.political_signal: null
records.policy_implication: This places the onus on the parties to resume relations, with the Security Council playing a supportive role.

records.record_text: The Mission recommends... That the Security Council should decide to appoint a person of standing, approved by the two Parties, to arrange for a preliminary meeting between the two Governments for the purpose of re-establishing relations... and the resumption of talks on matters in dispute, particularly the delimitation and marking of the common frontier.
records.political_signal: null
records.policy_implication: Proposes a concrete mediation mechanism (an appointed representative) to overcome the impasse and facilitate direct negotiations between the parties.

records.record_text: That the Security Council should take note of the assurances given to the Mission by the Government of the Republic of Viet-Nam that the Vietnamese armed forces have been issued definite instructions that every precaution is to be taken to avoid any risk of frontier violations.
records.political_signal: null
records.policy_implication: Formalizing this assurance through a Security Council action would increase its political weight and create a benchmark for future accountability.

records.record_text: That the Security Council should take note of the statement by the Government of the Republic of Viet-Nam that it recognizes and undertakes to respect the neutrality and territorial integrity of the Kingdom of Cambodia.
records.political_signal: null
records.policy_implication: This recommendation aims to lock in Viet-Nam's key political concession by having it formally acknowledged by the Security Council, thereby creating a new baseline for the bilateral relationship.
